lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-density distribution of circular, high-luminance pixel clusters across the cephalic and anterior lateral surfaces; spots exhibit reduced diameter and increased density toward the rostrum, transitioning to larger, more widely spaced clusters posteriorly.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Dominant horizontal linear feature on the upper flank characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and a distinct shadow-band on the ventral edge.
